legend: ✅ built in, or in an official package of the same project (named) · ⚠️ partial, opt-in, with a caveat, or through a third-party package (named) · ❌ not built in · 🔜 planned by the maintainers, no code yet · — does not apply. Every cell was checked against the source of the published package in October 2026.

rows.title: The definition is data (store, send, rebuild)

Issues as data: code, path, params
A result instead of an exception
Static type inferred from the schema

Snapshot of a schema or model

recursive.text: by name, a schema its own without a model; cycles tracked

jsTypes.text: Date, BigInt, Map, Set, Uint8Array; BSON (`./mongodb`)

refinements.text: `validate` on a field and a schema

i18n.text: en, uk; a locale per call

coercion.note: Opt-in, in parse only (check never converts): strict decimal strings, `true`/`false`/`1`/`0`, ISO dates with a zone, never the empty string; a value a union branch accepts as it is is not converted; `coerce()` is the step alone.

references.text: an id or the record, by kind or per call

derive.text: pick, omit, partial (deep), required, extend, keyof (`./derive`)

platforms.note: A minified bundle validates nothing but unknown keys: identity is checked by constructor.name === 'Type' (lib/util.js:42, lib/struct.js:34), which minifiers rename. esbuild minify without keepNames: { a: 1 } against { a: 'string' } is valid.

recursive.text: by entity name in a Model

customTypes.text: Model types: js alias or checkType

refinements.note: A field validate runs even when the type check already failed (both messages reported).

errorData.note: An unknown nested key loses its path: { nested: { extra } } reports Field "extra" (research-scripts/metarhia-basics.mjs).

unknownKeys.note: Keys named like Struct.prototype members (constructor, check, __proto__) pass silently: this[name] finds the inherited member (lib/struct.js:29-34).

dts.note: Only number/string/boolean are typed: a nested struct, enum, array or custom type is rendered as string (profile: string), and a reference as <name>Id: string although check validates the embedded record.

references.note: An id is never accepted, while the generated dts names the field companyId: string.

relations.note: The labels are reversed: a many field is labelled many-to-one and a single reference one-to-many.

noEval.text: object JIT by default; auto fallback
noEval.note: z.object builds a fast path with new Function when eval is allowed; a CSP probe (or z.config({ jitless: true })) switches to the interpreter. z.compile / "zod/compile" also use new Function and fall back to the runtime parser.

jsTypes.text: Date, BigInt, Map, Set, Symbol, File

cycles.note: The classic API installs a memoizer: a self-referencing value parses (output keeps the cycle), unless the cycle closes through a transform ($ZodCyclicError). zod/mini has no memoizer unless configured. 10 000-deep input overflows the stack.

derive.text: pick, omit, partial, required, extend, deepPartial

jsTypes.text: Date, BigInt, Map, Set, Blob, File

async.note: Async needs the parallel *Async API (objectAsync, pipeAsync, checkAsync). In plain JS, the sync safeParse of an async schema reports success: true for invalid input (the Promise has no issues); TypeScript forbids the call.

i18n.note: In @valibot/i18n 1.3.0 the CommonJS root entry does not load (index.cjs declares `var import_zh-CN`, a SyntaxError); ESM and per-locale imports work.

noEval.text: JIT by default; auto jitless under CSP

style.text: TS-syntax strings in object literals + chaining

jsTypes.text: Date, bigint, Map, Set, symbol, Blob, File…

async.note: A narrow that returns a Promise passes, because the predicate result is only tested for truthiness.

model.text: scope(): resolves names, errors on missing

formats.text: uuid, ulid, base64, URL, IP; no email

errorData.text: tagged issue tree; paths; check params

i18n.text: message annotations, formatter hooks; no locales

cycles.note: The RangeError surfaces as a defect: the Result/Exit adapters throw "Result adapter can only return schema issues".

standard.note: Schemas do not carry ~standard themselves ('~standard' in schema is false); wrap with Schema.toStandardSchemaV1 / toStandardJSONSchemaV1.

stream.note: Works on Effect Channels/Streams (unstable), not on Web Streams directly.

jit.note: Both are @stability unstable; the interpreter is the default.

version.note: No release since 2024-07; MetaMask publishes a maintained fork, `@metamask/superstruct`.

unknownKeys.text: object() rejects; type() ignores; mask() strips

defaults.note: Defaults apply only on the coercing calls (create, mask, validate with coerce: true), not in is()/assert().

tuples.note: A longer array is accepted and truncated, not rejected.

customTypes.text: new t.Type(name, is, validate, encode); no registry

async.note: TaskDecoder belongs to the experimental modules (lib/TaskDecoder.d.ts:2, "independent and backward-incompatible with stable ones").

errorData.text: context path, expected codec, value; no codes

unknownKeys.text: check ignores, parse strips, exact() rejects
unknownKeys.note: The same schema keeps unknown keys under check()/guard() and drops them under parse().

defaults.note: The default is a value, not a factory: default([]) hands every parse the same array (script).

customTypes.text: withPredicate/map on a base type; no registry

async.note: An async predicate silently passes every value (its promise is truthy).

cycles.text: the overflow caught as an issue
cycles.note: The RangeError of a cyclic or 3 000-deep value is returned as an issue whose path is thousands of keys long.

coercion.text: number coerce, date, bigint, enum case
coercion.note: Lenient: number().coerce() turns "1abc" into 1, number() accepts NaN, bigint() accepts true (script).

tuples.note: The invalid_length message is garbled in 0.5.5 ("expected an arraywith items", :852-866): a missing space and no count.

async.note: An async predicate silently passes every value.

formats.note: Regex-only: uuid() accepts versions 1-5 only (a v7 UUID fails) and datetime() does not check ranges.

errorData.text: type, params; path is a string

unknownKeys.note: noUnknown() strips unknown keys instead of rejecting them unless the schema is strict() (the README warns about it); exact() rejects.

standard.note: ~standard.validate always returns a promise and runs with abortEarly: false; array indexes come back as strings.

platforms.text: Node ≥ 20; browsers via a separate bundle
platforms.note: The browser bundle has no describe()/build() ('Manifest functionality disabled'), binary() or trace(); the main entry needs Node's url and util modules.

async.note: custom() given an async function passes and returns a Promise as the value (research-scripts/joi-extra.mjs).

coercion.note: number() also rejects values beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER unless unsafe() (types/number.js:104).

platforms.text: Node, Bun, Deno; browsers if eval is allowed
platforms.note: The compiled validator needs code generation, so it does not run on Cloudflare Workers or under a CSP without unsafe-eval.

optionalNullable.note: optional() lets null through and drops it from the output; nullable() keeps the key required; an absent key and undefined are the same.

formats.text: 18: email, url, uuid, ulid, ip, iban, jwt...

errorData.text: rule, meta; path is a dot string

unknownKeys.note: No way to reject unknown keys.

cycles.text: finite schemas; the unknown-key copy overflows

coercion.text: form semantics by default; { strict: true }

standard.text: v1 on validators; path is a string
standard.note: ~standard.validate puts the dotted field string in path (the specification wants an array) and, for a valid falsy output (false, 0, ''), returns { issues: undefined } without the value. Schemas themselves have no ~standard; vine.create() validators do.

noBuild.text: legacy TS decorators, or by hand
noBuild.note: Standard (TC39) decorators are not supported; class-transformer's implicit conversion also needs emitDecoratorMetadata.

asData.note: After registerSchema(), validating any decorated class throws the same TypeError (MetadataStorage.js:107).

async.note: validateSync() skips async validators silently and reports the value valid (Validator.js:31; script).

unknownKeys.note: whitelist deletes the keys from the validated object itself; forbidUnknownValues (default true) rejects an object with no metadata, so a plain object fails.

platforms.note: Runtimes that forbid eval (Cloudflare Workers, strict CSP) can only run validation code pre-generated with ajv/dist/standalone at build time.

formats.note: The core has none: in strict mode a schema with an unknown format fails to compile ("unknown format \"email\" ignored in schema").

allErrors.note: The Ajv security guide says not to use allErrors: true in production (research/ajv-src/docs/security.md:41).

errorData.text: keyword, params; path as JSON Pointer

cycles.text: RangeError; no detection or depth limit

defaults.note: Defaults are written into the input object, and not inside anyOf/oneOf/not.

introspection.text: the schema is a plain object

version.note: The legacy @sinclair/typebox 0.34.52 differs materially: CJS + ESM, Type.Date / Uint8Array and a TypeRegistry for custom kinds, and a Value.Parse that cleans, defaults and converts by default (research/typebox-legacy/node_modules/@sinclair/typebox/build/cjs/value/parse/parse.js:60-66).

noEval.text: Compile evals, falls back; Value never

formats.note: An unregistered format name passes silently: Format.Test returns true when the name is unknown (_registry.ts:103-106; typebox-behaviour.mjs).

jsTypes.note: Type.Date and Type.Uint8Array were removed in 1.0; the migration guide rebuilds them with Type.Unsafe + Type.Refine.

async.note: A refinement that returns a promise is not awaited: Value.Check returns true, and a compiled Check returns the Promise object itself, so the value is accepted.

errorData.text: keyword, params; path as JSON Pointer

cycles.text: RangeError; no detection or depth limit

defaults.note: Value.Parse and Compile().Parse never fill defaults (only with the global correctiveParse setting, and only for a value that fails the check); Value.Decode does, and Compile().Decode does only when the type contains a codec.

infer.text: Static<T>, also from plain JSON Schema

noEval.text: code is generated at build time

noBuild.note: Since v13 the transform is written in Go and run by ttsc on the TypeScript 7 native compiler (the first build compiled the plugin in 85 s); typia 12 is the legacy ts-patch setup for TypeScript < 7. Bundlers need @ttsc/unplugin.

jsTypes.text: Date, bigint, Map, Set, typed arrays
jsTypes.note: An invalid Date (new Date("nope")) passes as a Date, and NaN passes as a number unless the numeric/finite transform flags are set.

errorData.text: path string, expected, value; no code

unknownKeys.text: ignore default; equals rejects, prune strips
unknownKeys.note: equals accepts an extra key whose value is undefined.

cycles.note: A cycle is accepted (coinductive), and there is no depth limit.

infer.text: the TS type is the schema

jit.text: AOT at build time; no fallback

platforms.note: Built for browserify-era Node polyfills; and since every type is created with new Function, eval-free edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers) cannot load it.

jsTypes.text: Buffer; Date, BigInt via custom types
jsTypes.note: A JS Map passes a map type vacuously (it has no own keys): new Map([['a', 'x']]) is valid for values int and encodes as an empty map (lib/types.js:1799-1830).

compat.note: A resolver either builds or throws for one reader/writer pair; there is no backward/forward/full classification.

inferFromData.note: Any non-integer number below 2^53 is inferred as float (32-bit), which loses precision when encoded (lib/types.js:247-252).

jsTypes.note: verify() rejects a BigInt for int64 ("integer|Long expected") although fromObject and toObject accept it.

unknownKeys.note: Each policy belongs to a different API: verify ignores, fromObject strips, ProtoJSON fromJson rejects by default.

coercion.note: fromObject does not validate: { age: 'abc' } becomes 0 and { name: 42 } "42".

platforms.note: @mongoosejs/browser 0.1.3 is a prebuilt UMD (1.1 MB, 270 KB gzip) of mongoose 9.0.0-rc1 that validates documents only; its Node entry exports the driver, not mongoose, despite its README.

noThrow.note: validateSync is deprecated in 9.x and emits a process warning on every call (research-scripts/mongoose-custom.mjs); validate() rejects; the constructor throws for strict: 'throw' and cyclic input.

standard.note: On models only (a Schema has none), and validate always returns a promise; it casts, so { n: '5' } is valid with value n: 5.

references.note: A populated document is not validated with its own schema (an invalid Dog passes).
